matchMode.description: Defaults to exact equality. array-contains matches literal membership in a string array. string-contains matches a nonempty literal substring in one or more declared string fields. Uniqueness is by untouched original object.

items.description: Complete original objects; at most 32 MiB of compact serialized JSON, no truncation.

field.description: JSON pointer of at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes; string-contains also permits up to 32 pointers with any-field matching. One object matching several fields is still one match. Missing/non-string fields do not match. No URI decoding.

equals.description: Literal comparison value, at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes.

prefix.description: Literal prefix, at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes; empty is allowed.

stopBefore.description: Only with string-contains. After literal prefix removal, use the part of equals before the first occurrence of this literal marker; if absent use all. No trimming, case folding, entity decoding or change to original records.
